task: Diagnose and harden persistence of user profile changes across closing and relaunching the app. Trace ProfileStore rename/create/select and all UI callbacks that claim to save profile state. Keep the existing schema and paths. Make the shared JSON writer durable using a temp file flush+fsync before os.replace, fail closed on reparse paths, and verify read-back after profile rename/select writes so the callback reports an explicit saved-to-disk status or a clear failure. Ensure startup always reads persisted profile.json and voice_state.json from the application root, independent of cwd. Add concise Portuguese UI copy that profile changes are saved automatically and survive restart. Do not add a destructive save/reset behavior. Add focused tests that rename/select/create in a temporary store, instantiate a fresh ProfileStore, and prove names/active profile persist; test that invalid writes do not silently report success. Preserve current DELETE-only confirmation and all audio/profile isolation guards. Run py_compile, all tests, build_ui smoke, a real app restart/readback check without modifying user audio, and git diff --check. Do not run dataset preparation, training, generation or migration on real data. Do not change dependencies or .git metadata, and do not commit or push in the Executor task.
constraints: Canonical biel4 App Server/headless Executor only; no native subagents, create_thread, alternate backend, TUI or direct fallback.
Edit only app.py and focused tests; preserve all real profiles/audio exactly.
No destructive action, dependency install, commit or push in the Executor task.
Do not treat browser/session state as persistence; disk-backed profile.json and voice_state.json are authoritative.

review_findings.title: Persistence is implicit and unverified
review_findings.details: Rename/select call an atomic replace but do not fsync or read back the result, and the UI gives no durable-save confirmation. Strengthen the shared writer and callbacks while preserving the existing schema.

review_findings.title: Restart must be an acceptance check
review_findings.details: A fresh ProfileStore/app process must rediscover the persisted display name and active voice from the application-root files, not from cwd or in-memory Gradio state.
